assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of recurrent palpitations and documented episodes of supraventricular tachycardia and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, complicated by recent unexplained syncope.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to further characterize the arrhythmia burden and establish a correlation between cardiac rhythm disturbances and syncopal events.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197.
